name: Spiritual Weapon

targets.description: a creature within 5 feet of the spectral weapon, each attack

summary: A floating spectral weapon makes melee spell attacks for 1d8 + modifier Force; Bonus Action to move and attack.
text: You create a floating spectral force shaped like a weapon of your choice in a space within range; it lasts for the duration. When it appears you can immediately make one melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it, dealing Force damage equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier on a hit. As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can move it up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.
